# imranemon.tech

> Blog and portfolio of Imran Emon, a .NET and cloud infrastructure engineer.
> Posts are drawn from real production work — shipped systems, real incidents, and the fixes that followed.

## About

Imran Emon builds .NET backends and the infrastructure they run on: EF Core and
Hangfire inside the application; Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform
underneath it; AWS/Azure/GCP around it. Currently building VettifyNG, a legal
case management SaaS at https://app.vettify.site.

## Blog

Posts are plain markdown, published at /blog/<slug>/. Full text is open for
reading, indexing, and citation by both humans and AI agents. An RSS feed is
available at /rss.xml.

Topics: .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm,
Terraform, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), production incidents,
VPS hardening, and SaaS architecture.

## Projects

- VettifyNG — legal case management SaaS (4 portals, .NET 10, PostgreSQL, Docker): https://app.vettify.site
